Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1419.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuansou Xingduan. Yuansou Xingduan owns the retained deployment, dismissing the buddhas and the six as wash-water carriers before the summer seat.

Senses.Explanation: The six transmitters, summoned as one bench that hall addresses set their hearers against. Liao'an Qingyu opens the retreat furnace and seats the buddhas turning the wheel, the six patriarchs continuing the flame, and the old masters raising their gates inside one light; Cishou Huaishen, leaving the abbacy, counts the speech of the buddhas, the six, the old masters, and his own Zifu as one dream of three years and seven months; Chushi Fanqi's New Year's Eve xiaocan grants the like-this side to the buddhas' self-knowing and leaves the six no place to open their mouths; and Yuansou Xingduan asks what the buddhas and the six are but fellows who carry off wash-water. Dahui Zonggao tells his requester that one suddenly spoken phrase leaves the buddhas, the six, and the old masters standing to listen; Hongzhi Zhengjue's xiaocan rules that the buddhas cannot reach the hearer's crown and the six cannot see his heels; Mi'an Xianjie's Lantern Festival address seats the buddhas appearing and the six preaching and saving within light and shadow; and Gulin Qingmao names the one who cannot be called back, with the buddhas and the six as his fellow students.
